scientific_limitations: All-parameter formula is for labeled q-letter words with integer 2<=d<q and full-alphabet scattered subsequences; Gaussian limit is fixed-parameter and applies only for q-d>=2. title: Uniform renewal enumeration of window-injective subsequence-universal words
